== Summary ==
The '''Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List''' slip of [[Fleet Security Protocols (Errata 4)]] ('''PC-E4''', official text as of 27 April 2013), cropped from the Dark Side Master List, p. 25 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf]]; preserved copy: https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf), with the heading line above the slip. It shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank, as printed.

* '''Source:''' Players Committee, ''Virtual Cards: Master List'', Dark Side, "Official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014), p. 25.
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026, rendered at 200 dpi from the PDF page (PyMuPDF) and cropped; no other change.
* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text and layout by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
